node.statement: Apply the two-sided norm-control clause in def-extended-delta-inclusion to the map v_tilde from the preceding step, at amplification n=1 and the nonzero element 1 in C. It gives (1-c0*epsilon_*)||1|| <= ||v_tilde(1)|| <= (1+c0*epsilon_*)||1||. Because ||1||=1, transitivity yields 1-c0*epsilon_* <= 1+c0*epsilon_*, hence 0<=2*c0*epsilon_* and therefore c0>=0 since epsilon_*>0.
